scope.test_environment: Actual IdeaLake, CPU budget rows and empty strong capture_sources owner; all inspected interface methods are actual implementations. No worker, CLI or native action was launched by these five tests. Registry dictionaries are shallow-copied only to isolate test registration state.

conclusion: No blocking issue found within the reviewed interface/caller boundaries. Five first-green mechanisms validate callback metadata/authority contracts; they are not a proof of arbitrary trusted Python isolation or whole product integration.
review_findings: BoundPolicy receives detached queue/budget values, validates Execute against its independent captured queue and rechecks captured registry identity after callback return.

Domain.prepare receives detached request and source metadata. The original request's purpose, timeout and output contract are checked after the callback; changing received data cannot redefine the execution envelope.

Captured DomainRun and InterfaceContext have process-local strong registry ownership; constructor/copy/metadata lookalikes cannot pass the exact identity lookup. DomainRun action and metadata getters return detached values.

Registry implementation replacement during prepare or interpret is rejected before returning new authority or accepted claims. Trusted captured callables are not dynamically replaced from queued configuration.

cpu_execution pins parsed domain/policy declarations and actual invocation paths; cpu_phase rechecks admission before claiming and native launch. Source metadata alone is not a source capability; native uses the separate strong source capture.
The same existing CPU phase invokes the selected real Policy and Domain. Budget reserve/permit authority remains outside callbacks, independently bounds CPU execution, and is not a second executor.

After the first independent run, root narrowed error routing by wrapping ordinary interface initialization, policy evidence/decision and source/domain preparation exceptions as CPUExecutionError. Read-only diff found no removed authority gate; source change is between runs, not during either run.

test_cases.name: test_prepare_cannot_rewrite_captured_execution_envelope
test_cases.assertion: A real captured Domain changing timeout from 1 to 99 is rejected, with no new DomainRun or Lake/budget write.

test_cases.name: test_registration_replacement_inside_callback_cannot_return_authority
test_cases.assertion: Replacement of the actual registered entry during prepare or interpret is rejected; existing run becomes unavailable after replacement.

test_cases.name: test_policy_input_mutation_cannot_expand_execute_selection
test_cases.assertion: A policy appending an unlisted task to its detached queue and inflating its detached budget cannot select the foreign task or mutate caller/Lake state.

test_cases.name: test_run_copies_and_metadata_are_not_execution_capabilities
test_cases.assertion: The exact run is accepted; copy, newly constructed run and detached metadata are rejected. Returned action/metadata mutation does not replace capture.
